text:
From the very beginning, everything about our day on The Odyssey felt seamless and high-end. Communication was incredibly easy—they were responsive, friendly, and clear through the WhatsApp app, which made planning effortless.

The captain and first mate delivered truly exceptional service—professional, warm, and genuinely attentive. I started the day feeling pretty seasick, and they were so thoughtful and reassuring, checking on me often and doing everything they could to help. After having the lunch they provided, I felt much better and was able to fully enjoy the rest of the day.

While the fishing was slow in the morning, they were determined to find the right spots, and the afternoon completely turned around with nonstop action and plenty of fish. As someone who isn’t a seasoned fisherwoman (my husband has been fishing for years), I really appreciated how patient and encouraging they were, taking the time to teach me and make the experience fun and stress-free.

The boat itself was outstanding—very new, immaculate, and extremely well maintained. I’ve honestly never seen a cleaner bathroom on a boat. Every detail felt intentional and premium. Food service was handled with care; the captain put on gloves before touching any food, everything was kept cold in the cooler, and they even provided towels.

They truly provided everything you could need for the day—the only thing you need to bring is sunscreen. They finished the afternoon with a beautiful fresh fruit platter and fresh coconuts to drink from, which was such a thoughtful touch. They also brought a GoPro and captured amazing footage of us catching fish.

To top it all off, we got to choose the fish we wanted to keep, and we took it to a local restaurant where it was prepared for us.

An incredible day, breathtaking views, unforgettable memories, and true five-star service from start to finish. The Odyssey exceeded every expectation and is absolutely worth it.

We had an amazing experience on both the Sunset Tour and Phi Phi Islands Tour. A special thank you to Jimmy (Captain) and Sonny (Assistant) for making our trips so enjoyable.

Both of them were friendly, professional, and incredibly helpful throughout the tours. They were constantly looking out for us and always made sure we were safe and comfortable. They brought us to beautiful, breathtaking locations and timed our visits well, allowing us to enjoy the scenery without feeling rushed. We also appreciated the privacy they gave us, allowing our family to relax and fully enjoy each destination at our own pace.

Their care, attentiveness, and positive attitude made the experience truly memorable. Thank you, Jimmy and Sonny, for helping us create wonderful family memories in Krabi. We highly recommend them and would gladly join another tour with them in the future.

We did the fishing + 7 islands program with the boat ODYSSEY in Krabi and absolutely loved it. From start to finish everything was perfectly organized — they picked us up from our hotel and dropped us back, which made the whole day stress-free.

The crew was super friendly, professional, and helpful, always checking on us and catering to our needs. The boat itself is very well equipped — snorkeling gear, paddle board, and everything you could need for a full day on the water.

The lunch was very tasty with great presentation, and the fresh fruits provided were incredibly sweet and delicious. A real highlight was when the captain prepared sashimi on the spot from the fish we caught, which was an amazing and unforgettable touch.

Overall, an outstanding experience. Excellent captain, great crew, fantastic boat. Highly recommended — 10/10 🚤🌴🎣

Before we wrapped for the day, there was a platter of fresh fruit for our party to enjoy. Thank you Jimmy and Sonny!

We decided with my boyfriend to go to Krabi for a boat trip to Hong Island, and we chose Odyssey Tour Krabi and we’re really glad we did, because it was truly an amazing experience. My boyfriend loves fishing, so we combined the trip with fishing and snorkeling. We sailed around beautiful limestone cliffs and fished nearby. we managed to catch a beautiful fish, which they later served to us as sashimi—and we’ve never eaten anything better!
Drinks were available at all times, including fresh coconut. The lunch provided was also very good. The snorkeling was great. The guides were very kind and prepared lovely snacks and fruit for us. The boat was comfortable, and we really appreciated that it had a toilet. We couldn’t have chosen better.

Thank you for making our stay in Krabi more enjoyable! Highly recommend to everyone.

I had an incredible experience with Odyssey Travel Krabi on the Phi Phi Island tour!
The speedboat was clean, spacious, and very comfortable. One of the best parts was that the boat had an onboard toilet, which made the trip much more convenient — especially for a full-day tour.
The captain and crew were fantastic — professional, friendly, and very attentive. They made sure everyone was safe, relaxed, and having a great time throughout the journey.
We were also provided with snacks, soft drinks, fresh fruits, and cold water — all perfectly timed and refreshing during our boat ride.
Another fun touch: they had a Paddle Board for us to use while swimming and relaxing at the beach stops. It was a great way to enjoy the crystal-clear water even more.
Everything was well-organized and on time. This was a smooth, safe, and absolutely unforgettable trip. Thank you, Odyssey Travel! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Krabi.
